text: とびかかって　かみつく　まえぶれだ。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: とびかかって　かみつく　まえぶれ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing describes that thing. とびかかって　かみつく　まえぶれ = 'a sign that it will pounce and bite'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: とびかかって　かみつく
patterns.explanation: Ending the first action in て joins it to the next one, like 'and then'. とびかかって　かみつく = 'pounce and bite'.
